title: Hearty Juicy Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A kid-friendly Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, rye bread, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Meanwhile, toast the rye bread cubes on the grill for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Serve the lamb skewers with toasted rye bread and your choice of sides.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
